dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing of the visible 2D silhouette from the mid-back toward the posterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface, with prominent specular highlights along the right lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey patches distributed across the central dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between varying shades of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast dark circular feature is positioned on the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark circular mark or lesion is visible on the dorsal midline.
